title: Failure-mode census of 17 learned-policy experiments (primary assignment)
notes: Primary assignments of the 17 experiments classified in audit-05 section 4; secondary assignments are not plotted. Class (v) has zero members and was actively refuted twice (experiments 15 and 16: more data and capacity made ranking worse, and training initialized at exact fair D4 walked away from it). Classes (i) and (iii) dominate: information gaps in the oracle targets, and within-root discrimination even with complete sibling coverage. Zero of the seventeen failures is an optimization/basin failure — the class the owner's curriculum-ordering hypothesis targets. Evidence tier: audit of the historical ledger.
